test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All TVs are radios.

Some radios are mobiles.

All mobiles are pen drives.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some radios are pen drives.

(II) Some TVs are mobiles.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

All TVs are radios.

Some radios are mobiles.

All mobiles are pen drives.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48620ea416aa43cc84c816a26036b8850e58c28431bff6ff8fa3fa4c5cc46fec.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some radios are pen drives. - **True **(Because Some radios are mobiles and All mobiles are pen drives, so Some radios are also pen drives)

(II) Some TVs are mobiles. - **False **(Because there is no direct relation between TVs and mobiles so it can be possible but not definite)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
